email_body:
Dear NIKI Digital Engineering team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing and Communications Officer role. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I am drawn to NIKI's interdisciplinary approach and the opportunity to support strategic communication across energy, health, and automotive projects.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage client relationships, develop communication strategies for product launches, and create content that ranks. I have built and optimized websites for traditional and AI-powered search, using analytics to monitor and report on performance. My experience collaborating with interdisciplinary teams and managing projects from concept to execution aligns well with your task description.

I am fluent in English, comfortable with technical terminology, and eager to contribute to NIKI's innovative environment. I am VALIANT and ready to take on responsibility quickly.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your marketing and communications efforts.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear NIKI Digital Engineering team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing and Communications Officer position at NIKI Digital Engineering. Your focus on interdisciplinary collaboration and transferring know-how into practice resonates with my own approach to digital marketing, where I blend technical understanding with creative communication.

In my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in managing client relationships, developing communication strategies, and supporting marketing initiatives. For example, I built and optimized websites for clients such as mirook.com and majistraleczacilari.org.tr, where I implemented structured data, ran technical SEO audits, and created content that increased search visibility. I have also supported product launches by developing keyword-targeted content and monitoring public perception through analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console. These experiences have honed my ability to communicate effectively across disciplines and manage projects from concept to execution.

What draws me to NIKI is the opportunity to work in an innovative environment with talented individuals across energy, health, and automotive industries. I am eager to contribute to your communication strategies, support industry events, and help expand partnerships. My fluency in English, including technical terminology, and my analytical skills enable me to evaluate and report on communication initiatives effectively. I am a proactive problem-solver who thrives in collaborative settings and is ready to take on responsibility quickly.

I am VALIANT and confident that my mix of digital marketing, content creation, and technical skills can add value to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to NIKI's shared vision for progress.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
